name: Ao Seu Redor
source:
Follow Lilian's ordinary day as she performs tasks and interacts with her friends. Throughout the day Lilian will be faced with choices, and will realize how they affect those around her.

[Translated from [url=https://homens-do-pilar.itch.io/ao-seu-redor]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
跟随莉莉安的日常生活，了解她执行任务并与朋友互动的情况。一整天莉莉安都会面临选择，并会意识到它们如何影响她周围的人。

[译自[url=https://homens-do-pilar.itch.io/ao-seu-redor]Itch.io[/url]]
